Hi Sofia,

Thanks again for the initial SIG export — we reviewed your answers and have two areas that need clarification before we sign off:

1) Notification windows: your SIG answer references "timely notice" for impacted customers. Can you confirm the contractual or policy windows you follow (e.g., within 72 hours of confirmation, 30 days of detection, etc.)? We need a concrete range for our vendor risk team.

2) Point-of-contact availability: please provide the on-call escalation matrix (names + preferred contact method) for incident response POCs during business hours and after-hours. We will not publish mobile numbers but need a reliable escalation path.

Also attaching the SIG spreadsheet with highlighted rows (attached). Please include any SOC2 evidence that supports your IR assertions.

Appreciate a response by EOD Friday if possible — GreenFintech is near a procurement decision.

Best,
Aisha Dawson
Security Program Manager, GreenFintech
security@greenfintech.com

Hi Aisha — thanks for the clear ask. Short answers up front, details and attachments below.

1) Notification windows: Redwood commits to customer notification of confirmed data incidents within 72 hours of confirmation when feasible. That timeline is for customer-facing notifications; notification to regulators depends on jurisdiction and legal counsel, but we aim to provide supporting details to customers within 72 hours. For clarity in the SIG, we will mark the answer as: "Customer notification: targeted within 72 hours of incident confirmation; regulator notifications per applicable law and counsel."

2) POC / escalation matrix: we maintain a named on-call roster with 24/7 paging for severity-1 incidents and business-hours POCs for lower severities. For external partners we provide a secure contact list that includes primary on-call email, team pager, and a secure phone contact via an approved channel (DocuSign or our secure drive). Mobile numbers are not distributed in unencrypted email.

I attached a redacted IR_POC_matrix.csv (names, roles, primary pager) and our SOC2-summary-2026Q2.pdf which references incident handling controls and last tabletop drill date (2026-08-12).

If you want the full contact list with mobile numbers, let me know and I will route a secure DocuSign envelope to your security admin.

Proposed next step: 30-minute call Weds 10/7 to confirm wording for the SIG answers and share the secure contact method. Are you available 10/7 at 09:30 PT?

Regards,
Sofia Ivanova
Sr. Security & Trust Lead, Redwood Inference
sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai

Attachments: IR_POC_matrix.csv, SOC2-summary-2026Q2.pdf

Hi Sofia — thanks for the quick reply and for the attachments. A couple of follow-ups:

- For procurement, GreenFintech's security committee prefers a contractual commitment language. Would you agree to the following in a PSA addendum: "Redwood will notify impacted customers of confirmed incidents within 72 hours of confirmation, and will provide regular updates until the incident is resolved or contained." If legal needs different phrasing, please have your counsel propose alternatives.

- We also need to know how you escalate to executive leadership for incidents that may impact customers or reputational risk. Who is your escalation path for S1?

- Finally, could you confirm the date of your last live incident response escalation (not tabletop)? We understand this may be sensitive — a blinded summary is fine.

If you can confirm by EOD today, we'll try to finalize the SIG answers and move to procurement.

Thanks — Aisha

Aisha — answering inline below.

> Would you agree to the following in a PSA addendum...
We can accept the proposed language with a small clarification: "Redwood will notify impacted customers of confirmed incidents within 72 hours of confirmation when feasible; Redwood will provide regular status updates at least every 24 hours until containment or resolution, unless otherwise agreed." I copied legal and product (laura) for concurrence. If that works, our counsel can prepare a redline.

> Who is your escalation path for S1?
High-level escalation: on-call incident responder -> incident commander (senior SRE/security engineer) -> Head of Security (Sofia Ivanova) -> CTO (Vivek Kulkarni) -> CEO if required. For customer-facing escalations, we add the assigned Customer Success lead (Laura Bennett) to communications. I included a redacted chain in the attached CSV.

> Confirm date of last live IR escalation
We had a customer-impacting incident in 2025-11-21 that required an on-call S1 escalation and cross-functional incident command. We can provide a short blinded summary indicating scope and mitigation steps; sensitive artifacts will be shared under the existing NDA/secure channel only.

Next step: I'll have legal produce the PSA redline and schedule a short call to review. Please confirm a 30-minute window next week; I propose Tue 10/13 09:00 PT.

Best,
Sofia
